en.problem: Generated code cannot name the type (it is not `public`/`internal`, or it is `static` or a `ref struct`)
en.fix: Make the type and its containers `public` or `internal`

zh.problem: 生成代码无法引用该类型（它不是 `public`/`internal`，或者是 `static` 类或 `ref struct`）
zh.fix: 把该类型及其外层类型改为 `public` 或 `internal`

en.problem: The type must be `partial`: it serializes non-public members that generated code reaches through an accessor inside the type (before .NET 8; for generic types before .NET 9, or a member of a generic base with other type arguments), or it is `[NinoPooled]`
en.fix: Make the type and its containers `partial`

zh.problem: 类型必须是 `partial`：它要序列化的非公开成员需要通过类型内部的访问器访问（.NET 8 之前；泛型类型在 .NET 9 之前，或成员来自类型参数不同的泛型基类），或者标了 `[NinoPooled]`
zh.fix: 把该类型及其外层类型声明为 `partial`

en.problem: A subtype of a NinoType with `allowInheritance: false` has no formatter of its own: writing one throws
en.fix: Add `[NinoType]` to the subtype

zh.problem: 基类设置了 `allowInheritance: false`，子类型没有自己的格式化器：写入它会抛出异常
zh.fix: 给子类型加上 `[NinoType]`

en.problem: No usable constructor
en.fix: Add a parameterless constructor, one whose parameters match members, or `[NinoConstructor]`

zh.problem: 没有可用的构造函数
zh.fix: 添加无参构造函数、参数与成员对应的构造函数，或使用 `[NinoConstructor]`

en.problem: A `[NinoConstructor]` parameter matches no serialized member
en.fix: Rename the parameter or list the member names in the attribute

zh.problem: `[NinoConstructor]` 的某个参数找不到对应的序列化成员
zh.fix: 修改参数名，或在特性中列出成员名

en.problem: A read-only member is not a constructor parameter, so its value is read and dropped
en.fix: Add it to the constructor, make it settable, or `[NinoIgnore]` it

zh.problem: 只读成员不是构造函数参数，读出的值会被直接丢弃
zh.fix: 把它加入构造函数、改为可写，或用 `[NinoIgnore]` 忽略

en.problem: Invalid `[NinoFactory]` method
en.fix: Make it a non-generic `public static` method, callable without arguments, returning the declaring type

zh.problem: `[NinoFactory]` 方法无效
zh.fix: 改为可无参调用、返回声明类型的非泛型 `public static` 方法

en.problem: `[NinoConstructor]` is `private` or `protected`
en.fix: Make it `public` or `internal`

zh.problem: `[NinoConstructor]` 是 `private` 或 `protected` 的
zh.fix: 改为 `public` 或 `internal`

en.problem: `[NinoFactory]` next to a `[NinoConstructor]` is never called: the type is always re-created through the constructor
en.fix: Remove `[NinoFactory]` to keep re-creating, or `[NinoConstructor]` to fill factory instances in place

zh.problem: 类型有 `[NinoConstructor]`，`[NinoFactory]` 永远不会被调用：实例总是通过构造函数重新创建
zh.fix: 删掉 `[NinoFactory]` 则继续重建实例，删掉 `[NinoConstructor]` 则用工厂创建实例并原地填充

en.problem: Member type cannot be serialized: the member is skipped; or a generic `[NinoType]` in it is closed over such a type that its formatter writes (`Box<Action>`; a type argument it does not write is not counted): writing a value throws
en.fix: `[NinoIgnore]` it, or give it a custom formatter

zh.problem: 成员类型无法序列化，该成员会被跳过；或其中的泛型 `[NinoType]` 封闭在这样一个它的格式化器会写出的类型上（`Box<Action>`；不写出的类型参数不算），写入值时会抛出异常
zh.fix: 用 `[NinoIgnore]` 忽略，或为它提供自定义格式化器

en.problem: The `[NinoMemberFormatter]` type is not a struct that implements `INinoFormatter<T>` for exactly the member type
en.fix: Fix the formatter's type

zh.problem: `[NinoMemberFormatter]` 指定的类型不是结构体，或没有正好为该成员类型实现 `INinoFormatter<T>`
zh.fix: 修正格式化器的类型

en.problem: Non-public `[NinoMember]` in a type without `includeNonPublicMembers`
en.fix: Remove `[NinoMember]` or set `includeNonPublicMembers: true`

zh.problem: 类型没有设置 `includeNonPublicMembers`，却有非公开的 `[NinoMember]`
zh.fix: 移除 `[NinoMember]`，或设置 `includeNonPublicMembers: true`

en.problem: Redundant `[NinoMember]` with `autoCollect: true`
en.fix: Remove it

zh.problem: `autoCollect: true` 时 `[NinoMember]` 是多余的
zh.fix: 移除它

en.problem: Redundant `[NinoIgnore]` with `autoCollect: false`
en.fix: Remove it

zh.problem: `autoCollect: false` 时 `[NinoIgnore]` 是多余的
zh.fix: 移除它

en.problem: Member has both `[NinoMember]` and `[NinoIgnore]`
en.fix: Remove one or both

zh.problem: 成员同时标记了 `[NinoMember]` 和 `[NinoIgnore]`
zh.fix: 移除其中一个或两个

en.problem: Duplicate `[NinoMember]` index
en.fix: Use the next free index

zh.problem: `[NinoMember]` 索引重复
zh.fix: 改用下一个空闲索引

en.problem: A non-public base member hidden with `new` cannot be reached (it can through `[UnsafeAccessor]`: .NET 8+, generic types .NET 9+); it is skipped
en.fix: Rename one of the members, or make it public

zh.problem: 基类中被 `new` 隐藏的非公开成员无法访问（通过 `[UnsafeAccessor]` 可以访问：.NET 8+，泛型类型 .NET 9+），会被跳过
zh.fix: 重命名其中一个成员，或改为公共成员

en.problem: A struct serializes no members: it would be zero bytes, and a collection of it could not be read back
en.fix: Serialize a member, or make the struct `VersionTolerant` or `Keyed`

zh.problem: 结构体没有任何成员参与序列化：会被写成 0 字节，由它组成的集合无法读回
zh.fix: 至少序列化一个成员，或设为 `VersionTolerant` 或 `Keyed`

en.problem: `[NinoMember]` on a member that is never serialized (static, constant, indexer, fixed-size buffer, a property without a getter or implemented explicitly, a property without a setter that no constructor takes, or `[field: NinoMember]`): nothing is written for it; this is the only diagnostic about that attribute
en.fix: Remove `[NinoMember]`; to serialize a get-only auto-property, give a constructor a parameter of its name

zh.problem: `[NinoMember]` 标在永远不会被序列化的成员上（静态成员、常量、索引器、固定大小缓冲区、没有 getter 或显式实现接口的属性、没有 setter 且没有构造函数接收的属性，或 `[field: NinoMember]`）：这个成员什么都不写；关于这个特性只报这一条诊断
zh.fix: 去掉 `[NinoMember]`；要序列化只读自动属性，给构造函数加一个同名参数

en.problem: A member or a `NinoSerializer`/`NinoDeserializer` call needs `System.Numerics.Vector<T>`: directly, as an element or type argument, inside a plain struct at any depth, or through a generic `[NinoType]` that writes it (`Box<Vector<int>>`); Nino.Core formatters and `Writer`/`Reader` methods used by hand are checked too, made or only held in a field, property or local. `Vector<T>` is 16, 32 or 64 bytes depending on the CPU, so no host reads every other host's bytes, and the runtime throws `NotSupportedException`. Ignored members, type arguments a type never writes and your own formatter that writes the lanes are not reported
en.fix: Store a fixed number of lanes (an array, `Vector128<T>`/`Vector256<T>`) and expose the vectors through `[NinoIgnore]` members ([`Vector<T>` Is Not Serializable](/en/docs/v4/struct-layouts#vector-t))

zh.problem: 成员或 `NinoSerializer`/`NinoDeserializer` 调用需要 `System.Numerics.Vector<T>`：直接出现，作为元素或类型参数，在任意深度的普通结构体里，或经由会写出它的泛型 `[NinoType]`（`Box<Vector<int>>`）；手写使用的 Nino.Core 格式化器和 `Writer`/`Reader` 方法同样检查，无论是创建出来还是只放在字段、属性或局部变量里。`Vector<T>` 的大小由 CPU 决定（16、32 或 64 字节），没有哪个平台能读回所有其他平台写的字节，运行时也会抛 `NotSupportedException`。被忽略的成员、类型从不写出的类型参数，以及自行写出各通道的格式化器不报
zh.fix: 存固定数量的通道（数组、`Vector128<T>`/`Vector256<T>`），再通过标了 `[NinoIgnore]` 的成员提供向量（见[`Vector<T>` 不能序列化](/zh/docs/v4/struct-layouts#vector-t)）

en.problem: Two keyed members (or a member's `[NinoFormerName]`) hash to the same key
en.fix: Rename one of them, or drop the former name

zh.problem: 两个键控成员（或某个成员的 `[NinoFormerName]`）哈希到同一个键
zh.fix: 重命名其中一个，或去掉该旧名称

en.problem: `[NinoFormerName]` has no effect outside a keyed type: positional and version-tolerant types write no member names
en.fix: Remove it, or give the type `format: NinoFormat.Keyed`

zh.problem: `[NinoFormerName]` 只在键控类型中起作用：按位置和版本容错的类型都不写成员名
zh.fix: 删除它，或给类型设置 `format: NinoFormat.Keyed`

en.problem: More than one `[NinoFormerName]` on a type: its type id comes from a single earlier name
en.fix: Keep only the name the data you still read was written under

zh.problem: 一个类型上有多个 `[NinoFormerName]`：类型 ID 只能由一个旧名称计算
zh.fix: 只保留仍要读取的数据写出时用的那个名称

en.problem: `[NinoFormerName]` on a generic type written with a type id: every instantiation takes the same id
en.fix: Remove the former name, or keep former names on non-generic types

zh.problem: 会带类型 ID 写入的泛型类型上有 `[NinoFormerName]`：它的每个实例化都得到同一个 ID
zh.fix: 去掉旧名称，或只在非泛型类型上使用旧名称

en.problem: `trackReferences` on a struct is ignored
en.fix: Remove `trackReferences`

zh.problem: `trackReferences` 用在结构体上会被忽略
zh.fix: 移除 `trackReferences`

en.problem: `trackReferences` on a type re-created from its constructor (e.g. a positional record)
en.fix: Make the members assignable

zh.problem: `trackReferences` 用在了要通过构造函数重新创建的类型上（例如位置记录）
zh.fix: 让成员可以赋值

en.problem: `[NinoPooled]` on a type that cannot be pooled (not a sealed class filled in place)
en.fix: Seal the class and make its members assignable

zh.problem: `[NinoPooled]` 用在了无法池化的类型上（不是能原地填充的密封类）
zh.fix: 把类声明为 `sealed`，并让成员可以赋值

en.problem: `[NinoPooled]` class does not implement `OnNinoPoolWarmup` / `OnNinoPoolReturn`
en.fix: Implement both partial methods (`OnNinoPoolReturn` may be empty; `OnNinoPoolWarmup` may return an empty sequence)

zh.problem: `[NinoPooled]` 类没有实现 `OnNinoPoolWarmup` / `OnNinoPoolReturn`
zh.fix: 实现这两个 partial 方法（`OnNinoPoolReturn` 方法体可以为空；`OnNinoPoolWarmup` 可以返回空序列）

en.problem: Invalid `[assembly: NinoFormatter]` registration; it is ignored
en.fix:
Register a struct, not nested in a generic type, that implements `INinoFormatter

` once: a generic one as its open definition (`typeof(F<,>)`), with type parameters that can be inferred, a non-generic one as itself (`typeof(F)`)

zh.problem: `[assembly: NinoFormatter]` 注册无效，会被忽略
zh.fix:
注册一个只实现一次 `INinoFormatter

`、且没有嵌套在泛型类型中的结构体：泛型结构体以开放泛型定义（`typeof(F<,>)`）传入，所有类型参数都要能推断；非泛型结构体直接传入（`typeof(F)`）

en.problem: Invalid arguments or `<NinoCodegen>` metadata (an unknown option, one given twice or of another language, a value it does not take), or an assembly it cannot read
en.fix: Fix the option or the item

zh.problem: 参数或 `<NinoCodegen>` 元数据无效（未知选项、重复给出或属于其他语言的选项、不被接受的值），或无法读取程序集
zh.fix: 修正选项或项

en.problem: A type is left out because the language cannot express it
en.fix: See [What Is Not Generated](/en/docs/v4/advanced/codegen#not-generated)

zh.problem: 某个类型因目标语言无法表达而被跳过
zh.fix: 见[不会生成的内容](/zh/docs/v4/advanced/codegen#not-generated)

en.problem: The project sets Nino.TypeScript's `NinoTypeScript*` properties
en.fix: Declare a `<NinoCodegen>` item instead ([migration](/en/docs/v4/advanced/codegen#from-ninotypescript))

zh.problem: 项目设置了 Nino.TypeScript 的 `NinoTypeScript*` 属性
zh.fix: 改为声明 `<NinoCodegen>` 项（[迁移](/zh/docs/v4/advanced/codegen#from-ninotypescript)）

en.problem: The project references Nino.Codegen but declares no `<NinoCodegen>` item
en.fix: Add one, or set `NinoCodegenEnabled` to `false`

zh.problem: 项目引用了 Nino.Codegen，却没有声明 `<NinoCodegen>` 项
zh.fix: 添加一项，或把 `NinoCodegenEnabled` 设为 `false`
